text.en: Noun phrases in Ainu have no grammatical marking for the syntactic roles of subject and object ⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--noun-phrases-in-ainu-have-no-grammatical-marking⟧. The basic structure of Ainu sentences is determined primarily by verbal valency and five structures based on typological properties of head-marking languages ⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--the-basic-structure-of-ainu-sentences-is-determined⟧. A sentence may appear as independent noun phrase(s) and a predicate, or as a predicate marked for person without an independent noun phrase ⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--an-ainu-sentence-may-appear-as-independent-noun⟧. Basic sentences are determined according to the type of verb, specifically as a one-place, two-place, three-place, or copula verb ⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--ainu-basic-sentences-are-determined-according-to-the⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語において、名詞句には主語および目的語という統語的役割の標示が存在しない⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--noun-phrases-in-ainu-have-no-grammatical-marking⟧。アイヌ語の文の基本構造は主として動詞の結合価と、主要部標示言語の類型論的性質に基づく5つの構造によって決定される⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--the-basic-structure-of-ainu-sentences-is-determined⟧。文は独立した名詞句と述語から構成されることもあれば、名詞句を伴わず人称標示された述語のみで現れることもある⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--an-ainu-sentence-may-appear-as-independent-noun⟧。基本文は動詞のタイプ（1項動詞、2項動詞、3項動詞、繋辞動詞）に応じて決定される⟦claim:clause/constituent-order-head-final--ainu-basic-sentences-are-determined-according-to-the⟧。
